A good way to end the night and begin the day. And they had us at “hello!” Thanks for a great run Stephen Colbert!


Spencer Althouse (@SpencerAlthouse)

this was so sweet. Stephen Colbert just ended his final episode of The Late Show while singing "Hello, Goodbye" with Paul McCartney. his family and the show's crew then joined them on stage before Paul turned off the lights to the Ed Sullivan Theater

For 11 years, Stephen Colbert has brought humor and heart to late-night television. It was a privilege to join him on that stage. Thank you, Stephen, and wishing you all the best in your next chapter.

Justice served. Minnesotans deserve this accountability. 

Thanks to the prosecutors and investigators who worked on this case.

The former leader of a Minnesota nonprofit has been sentenced to nearly 42 years in prison for her role in a staggering $250 million fraud case. apnews.com/article/fraud-min…

NEWS: The Senate voted today to put a check on President Trump’s power — and give Congress the say in bringing his war in Iran to an end.

I’m grateful to all my colleagues, including 4 Republicans, who joined us in reaffirming Congress’s constitutional authority over going to war.

Minnesotans deserve a government that can carry its weight and match their drive and ambition.

If you give me the opportunity to serve as your governor, I will work every day to build a government that solves problems and delivers results for the people it serves.

Video

No matter where you live, you should have access to reliable high-speed internet.

Now my bipartisan Rural Broadband Protection Act has been signed into law — making sure funding goes to providers who can get the job done.  

kaaltv.com/news/klobuchar-bi…

It’s official! Minnesota will host the 2028 NFL draft.

Was glad to be part of the team making the case for our state & we’ll be ready to roll out the red carpet for NFL fans visiting from all across the country. #SKOL


Minnesota Vikings (@Vikings)

📍 Minnesota

Minnesota will host the 2028 @NFL Draft. 

📰: mnvkn.gs/4lNfOoi





— https://nitter.net/Vikings/status/2056770027215577409#m

One year ago, the TAKE IT DOWN Act was signed into law. And Minnesota is now the first state to ban nudification technology entirely.

No one should have their life destroyed by non-consensual intimate images or AI deepfakes, and this law is helping protect victims.

Video

More details on attack in Kuwait.
We lost Minnesotan soldier and mom Nicole Amor in this attack. 

Troops say Army ignored request for more medical support before deadly attack on Kuwait base - CBS News cbsnews.com/news/troops-army…

My friend Gov. @gretchenwhitmer said it best — in the Midwest, we’re not afraid to work hard.

But if we want to make a better future for all Minnesotans, we have to train our workers on the technology of today and build on our culture of innovation.

Video

After two of their employees lost their home to the wildfires, the Rustic Inn Cafe in Two Harbors stepped up to collect donations and serve free meals to first responders and those impacted by the fires.

One of the many examples of Minnesotans showing up for one another in a time of need.

Video

As anyone in the checkout line knows, grocery prices are way up. In just one year:

Beef prices are up 14.8%
Vegetables are up 11.5%
Coffee is up 18.5%

The President promised to lower costs for families on Day One. He hasn't delivered.

The Hmong community in Minnesota is a vital part of our state. A great example of that is Hmong Village in Saint Paul. Visited with Mayor Her to see the thriving small businesses and recognize the contributions Hmong Minnesotans make to our economy and culture.

Video

BREAKING: The Supreme Court rejected Big Pharma’s appeal to stop Medicare from negotiating lower drug prices. I led this law in 2022, and it has since saved seniors and taxpayers billions of dollars.

Today is an important win for everyone who wants lower prescription drug costs.
